in_arabic.name: Basita
in_arabic.long_meaning: Basita هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'sata', meaning 'to sit'. In Islamic tradition, the name Basita is a symbol of tranquility and peace. It is said that the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) named his granddaughter Basitah, meaning 'the resting one', as a sign of the peace and contentment she brought to his household.
